settings.passage_selection: maximum raw cross-encoder score over existing representative passages
settings.score_activation: identity (raw logits); no combination with retrieval scores
settings.pair_truncation: longest_first to 512 tokens including query, passage, and special tokens
settings.aggregation: macro mean over every test-qrels query

performance.query_timing_scope: unchanged hybrid candidates, pair preparation, batched cross-encoder prediction, max passage aggregation, final document ranking
performance.inference_timing_scope: CrossEncoder.predict plus score array conversion; includes pair tokenization/inference
performance.total_timing_scope: load/validate, model loads, cache/index preparation, online retrieval/reranking, metrics/report; excludes JSON write
